dct_title_s: Bushkill Brook, New Jersey Aerial Photograph
dct_description_sm: This is an aerial photograph from the NJ Department of Enivronmental Protection Aerial Photographs Collection showing Bushkill Brook, a tributary of South Branch of the Raritan River. The south branch of the river flows through Morris and Hunterdon counties and along the western edge of Somerset County.
